svg.title: Proof. Write E± = F± +H±. Then WE −εQE = WF −εQF + P y tr(HyAy). The duality of operator and trace norms bounds each term by r∥Ay∥1, with equality at Hy = r sign(Ay). Condition (64) makes these effects positive and keeps F∅−H+ −H−≥0, so they are a real physical POVM. For success use H+ = H−= −rI, which is also physical in that regime. The denominator is positive when QF > 2r; the first inequality then implies the conditional-error statement. References do not alter nominated label probabilities. □ There is also a complete pointer/reference guarantee. For the channel ME(ρ) = P y tr(Eyρ)|y⟩⟨y|,
